item.title: Multimodal monitoring of pan-enteric mucosal healing and biologic persistence in Crohn's disease-the MILESTONE-CD prospective cohort.
item.description: Journal of Crohn's & colitis - Observational study - Mucosal healing (MH) is associated with improved long-term outcomes in Crohn's disease (CD), but longitudinal pan-enteric data are limited. This prospective observational study enrolled adults with...
